top_signals.title: Vontobel Co-CEO: Higher Rates Not a Problem per Se, Pace Can Be
top_signals.summary: Christel Rendu De Lint, Co-CEO of Vontobel, on AI, cyber risks and if UBS left Switzerland. 'I would prefer them to stay. It's a brand for the Swiss economy, losing a major brand, a major actor, it's a loss'. She speaks on Bloomberg's "The Opening Trade" with Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Russian-speaking Brooklyn residents began tipping off local authorities to a cryptocurrency fraud scheme three years ago, leading to an operation to take down the associated servers and domains.

top_signals.title: Stena Line Acquires RoRo Vessel
top_signals.summary: Stena Line reached an agreement to acquire the RoRo vessel Somerset from CLdN. Somerset is a 1999-built 183.4m RoRo with 2,504 lane meters. The deal is subject to closure and transfer, the vessel would begin operating on the Dublin–Liverpool route for Stena Line in early December.
